prompt: Climb something on foot and, before your breathing settles, say out loud how bad it was and what talked you into it.

rubric.ideal: That was about fifteen minutes straight up a gravel path and for the last third of it I was stopping every twenty steps.
My legs are shaking, I cannot get a full sentence out without a breath in the middle of it, and my ears are hot.
I came up because I have looked at this hill from the bus for four years without ever going up it.
